text_block_list.text: I managed to get on the board, at least, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just as usual, huh.
I ended up totally overwhelmed by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Changing myself from a "supporting role"... really is difficult, isn't it?

Trainer...

True, I was able to
give it everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...All we can do is keep on training!
choice_data_list: Next time, show me you as the star of the show!
Next time, show me you as the star of the show, okay?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. It can't go on like this.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
――I want to change.
The way I am right now.
choice_data_list: In that case... gotta keep running.
In that case... you have to keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
I'll run and run... even further than I am now!
